main.description: Delete a release record the caller published. This is how a publisher withdraws a release: it deletes from the caller's own repo as them, where com.atproto.repo.deleteRecord sent through a HappyView instance goes wherever that instance's proxy routing points. The release stays indexed and served by exact version, marked withdrawn, and the version can never be published again.

version.description: The version to withdraw, as published.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The caller's identity could not be determined, so there is no repo to delete from.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The slug or version could not name a release.

errors.name: ReleaseNotFound
errors.description: That version is not published from the caller's account, or was already withdrawn.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The record could not be deleted from the caller's repo.

errors.name: NotConfigured
errors.description: The registry has no identity configured.
